successors.name: Machalilla Culture
successors.text: the Santa Elena peninsula; the page lists only 'Followed by: Machalilla culture, Cotocollao culture' and gives no land for either

ledger.x: 3800 BCE: the Valdivia culture begins on the coast of the Santa Elena peninsula, Ecuador.
1500 BCE: the Valdivia culture ends and the Machalilla culture follows.

certainty.note: No border is recorded; the coast of the Santa Elena peninsula is the only extent the page names.
